reading.title: Scorpio Sun, Void Moon
overview: The Sun at 11° Scorpio conjoins retrograde Mercury while Venus rules from 25° Libra retrograde and sextiles Jupiter. Mars conjoins Jupiter in Leo, Mercury squares Mars, and Saturn conjoins Neptune in Aries. The Moon at 6° Virgo remains void of course until 5 November, with outer aspects including Uranus trine Pluto and Neptune sextile Pluto.

Mundane tradition reads the Scorpio emphasis and Mercury-Sun conjunction as concentrated attention on intelligence, hidden resources and official statements. The void Moon period is held to favour continuation of existing conditions over fresh initiatives. Saturn-Neptune conjunction and the outer-planet aspects point to gradual institutional erosion alongside slow realignments in collective assumptions.

Transits to national angles remain within the stated 2° orbs for the United States, Russia, Ukraine, Israel, Iran, China, Taiwan and North Korea, each carrying the houses and lunation placements noted in the computed data.

nations.reading: Neptune opposes the Sibly MC while Saturn sextiles natal Uranus. These contacts coincide with reporting on US strikes against Iranian targets and routine post-midterm coverage; the fair-test data for related claims remain at chance levels.

Neptune squares the 1991 Sun, Mars trines the MC and natal Mars, and Uranus trines natal Saturn. Today's items on Russian strikes in Dnipro and cyber-group dismantlement fall under these degrees; records show no departure from chance for Mars-related personnel-loss predictions.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn and Neptune sextiles it while Saturn squares natal Uranus. The lunation falls in the sixth house; linked reporting on energy strikes and aid-route espionage sits within the listed orbs, yet full-moon and Mars-affliction tests register no predictive gain.

Pluto opposes natal Moon and Jupiter squares the Sun. The sixth-house lunation placement is noted; associated items on regional targets and diplomacy remain inside the computed transits, with rocket-alert records showing chance performance.
Pluto conjoins the Moon and ASC while Saturn opposes the Sun. The fourth-house lunation is recorded; no direct overlap with today's listed items appears for this chart.

reading.lore_and_intel: Venus sextile Jupiter, Neptune sextile Pluto, Uranus trine Pluto, Sun-Mercury conjunction and Mars-Jupiter conjunction align with the supplied items on UK warship tracking, Russian strikes, Iranian targets, cyber operations and diplomatic invitations. Saturn-Neptune conjunction matches energy-infrastructure reporting. No computed overlap exists for Barcelona-Aston Villa coverage or unrelated quiet theatres; the fair-test verdicts apply uniformly across all listed claims.

reading.the_test: Multiple tests over 1676–9764 days find Mars afflictions, full moons and eclipses perform no better than chance for Ukraine air-raid alarms, Israeli alerts, Russian losses or worldwide magnitude-6+ earthquakes. The records therefore supply no evidence that these astrological factors predict the events in question.
